_doc: Exclusion list: what must NOT reach the prompt triage.
The real triage is done by prompts/rapport-securite.md, which reads the article.
This file only removes bulk noise identified by name.
An entry is dropped if `motif` (regular expression, case-insensitive) is
found in its title AND if `source` is absent or appears in the name of its
Golden rule: when in doubt, do not exclude. An article dropped here is
invisible — it will not even appear in the bulletin's « Articles écartés »
section. One article too many, on the other hand, is settled in one line at triage.
Every rule is counted in output/candidates.json, section `excluded`:
that is what shows a rule going off the rails or no longer earning its place.
